title: Agent uses widget chart.scatter
prompt:
Write a Viva artifact using a TOP-LEVEL `widget chart.scatter`.

CRITICAL SYNTAX:
- `widget chart.scatter` is TOP-LEVEL (sibling of scene), NOT `widget: chart.scatter` inside a layer.
- Include data points, xField/yField, xlim/ylim, areaX/areaY as number pairs.

Output ONLY valid Viva source starting with artifact.
